newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Elliott retires hurt after mid-pitch collision.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Elliott retires hurt after mid-pitch collision.

text.p: Australia opener Matthew Elliott retired hurt on 78 after a mid-pitch collision with batting partner Mark Waugh in the second test against West Indies on Monday.
Elliott and Waugh collided heavily while running between the wickets, Elliott barely making his ground before Carl Hooper threw down the stumps.
Waugh was on 31 and Australia were 143 for two when the incident occurred.
Elliott limped from the field after apparently injuring his right leg and was replaced at the crease by Michael Bevan. He had taken his score from 45 after Australia resumed on 77 for two.
